GROUP BY 
    customer_id
ORDER BY 
    total_spent DESC

SELECT 
    customer_id,
    SUM(total_amount) AS total_spent
FROM 
    customers
GROUP BY 
    customer_id
ORDER BY 
    total_spent DESC
LIMIT 5;
```
